summary: Settings (B4: sections with their own addresses, profiles and parental controls, your profile), two rounds by one fresh-context reviewer with the server handlers read. Round 1 at dfb6028 fix-first: the limit dropdown wrote on change, so one arrow key on the closed select saved a looser limit and typing N removed it, with only a limit on the watching profile confirmed; the destructive confirmations were inline swaps that dropped focus and announced nothing. Round 2 at 8809f45 lows-only: a limit is held until Save, any loosening and every removal asks first, the confirmations are the app's alert dialog with focus returned, a TV-Y7 tier was added and every label is checked against the server's ladder; lows: the profiles pane trusts its own copy of the list over the app's when older (a newly restricted session keeps rows and controls until a reload; the server refuses writes), loosening is judged against the row's possibly stale stored limit, focus is lost after Make default and Set or Change PIN, a delete dialog left open across a cross-tab switch onto the named profile deletes the acting profile. Routes and payloads match the server; the five removed settings have no reader; CLAUDE.md and docs/push.md edits true. Applied by cherry-pick; every Settings file byte-identical to the reviewed head, with App.tsx, index.css and CLAUDE.md differing only by another builder's unlanded work.
